name: Weather notifier
author: ModuForge
description: Every half hour fetches the current temperature for a city from wttr.in and posts a notification when it changes by a degree or more. The city is asked once and can be changed on the module's screen.

permissionReasons.FILE_SANDBOXED: Keeps the city and the last temperature.
permissionReasons.NOTIFICATIONS: Tells you when the temperature changes.
permissionReasons.BACKGROUND_EXECUTION: Keeps checking while the app is not on screen.
